question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Beloved, and Claire gets The Trial.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Beloved
(C) The Trial
solution:
Each row lists books in order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: Jane Eyre, Beloved, The Trial.
After Claire–Bob: Jane Eyre, The Trial, Beloved.
After Alice–Bob: The Trial, Jane Eyre, Beloved.
After Claire–Bob: The Trial, Beloved, Jane Eyre.
Alice has The Trial, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
